title: Tame Z-Covers Of Locally Profinite Groups
body_html:
Tame Z-Covers Of Locally Profinite Groups

Let $G$ be a locally profinite group and let $Z$ be a finite abelian group. A $Z$-cover of $G$ is a topological central extension

$$ 1\to Z\to \widetilde G\to G\to 1, $$

where $Z$ is discrete and the projection $\widetilde G\to G$ is a covering map.

The draft calls this cover tame if

$$ |G|_\infty\wedge |Z|=1. $$

It is called wild otherwise.

A compact subgroup $H\subset G$ is called $Z'$-compact in the draft if

$$ |H|\wedge |Z|=1. $$

Draft Caution

The name "$Z'$-compact" appears to mean "prime-to-$Z$ compact" rather than a new subgroup $Z'$. This should be renamed before becoming final paper notation.
